scope: Quote identity support only; no football labels or treatment scores
sql:
SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
 COUNTIF(event_id IS NULL OR TRIM(event_id)='') AS missing_event_id,
 COUNTIF(SAFE_CAST(snapshot_ts AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL) AS invalid_snapshot,
 COUNTIF(bookmaker IS NULL OR player IS NULL OR market IS NULL OR outcome_name IS NULL) AS missing_quote_identity,
 COUNTIF(price IS NULL) AS missing_price,
 COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS events
 FROM `nfl-predictions-503414.nfl_raw.prop_lines`
 WHERE market IN ('player_pass_yds','player_pass_tds','player_rush_yds','player_reception_yds','player_receptions','player_anytime_td')
 GROUP BY season ORDER BY season
